question: Should LiteLLM's interactive onboarding path prompt for a proxy base URL and model selection, or should URL-based LiteLLM setup remain routed through Custom Provider and non-interactive flags only?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable fix crosses product and security boundaries around provider-specific prompts, stored proxy URLs, and possible credentialed model discovery.

options.title: Add LiteLLM interactive URL setup
options.body: Implement a provider-owned interactive LiteLLM setup that asks for or confirms the proxy base URL, stores it with the API-key profile, and keeps model discovery conservative unless separately approved.

options.title: Route remote proxies to Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM's named auth choice as localhost/default-model oriented and update docs or wizard copy so remote LiteLLM users choose Custom Provider or non-interactive flags.

options.title: Defer model discovery
options.body: Fix only the missing interactive base URL prompt now and track credentialed model discovery as a separate provider UX decision.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM interactive URL setup
recommendation.body: Implement a provider-owned interactive LiteLLM setup that asks for or confirms the proxy base URL, stores it with the API-key profile, and keeps model discovery conservative unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent LiteLLM onboarding pluginization and the shipped partial fix make this the closest current-main owner signal for the product-shape decision.
